input: The sizes of the places from the application layout contract (left share, divider, minimum widths, monitor, head row and dock heights) and the faces.
output: The one desktop board every application uses: monitor, head row and body of the left column, right panel and dock; it calls the caller for each place. A place of size 1 shows nothing. It knows no application, keeps no state and never reads or writes the database.
specification: User rule 2026-09-30: every application uses the same layout, only the sizes of its places and the blocks in them differ; geometry from qnc-editorial-desktop render_desktop/render_board and qnc-project-desktop project_board.
